summary: OpenMediaVault is a network-attached storage solution built on Debian Linux. It provides out-of-the-box file sharing and utility services such as SSH, FTP, SMB, and BitTorrent clients.
goodFor: Users who want to set up a dedicated file server on Debian hardware and prefer a web-managed interface for standard network storage protocols.
watchOut: You should check whether its plugin ecosystem and default feature set meet your specific storage requirements, as it relies heavily on Debian packages.
deployNotes: As a PHP-based application running on Linux, it typically requires persistent storage for your configuration and data, along with appropriate file permissions.
